question_en: List the agreements on SRS configuration (SRS configuration decisions).
original_Cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'SRS' AND a.content CONTAINS 'configuration' RETURN m.meetingNumber, a.resolutionId, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, a.resolutionId LIMIT 10
